frequency_question: What fraction of announced major industrial subsidy frameworks are finalized and implemented within a ~12-month window?
membership_rule: Includes central government financial incentive frameworks for heavy industry, automotive, or transport sectors announced for development; excludes minor amendments, localized state-level schemes, or non-financial policy guidelines.
window: 358 days from formal proposal or initiation stage.

cases.name: Production Linked Incentive (PLI) for Advanced Chemistry Cell Battery
Production Linked Incentive (PLI) for Auto and Auto Components
National Green Hydrogen Mission implementation guidelines

provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 7 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 7 named major transport/industrial subsidy schemes in the relevant jurisdiction; all achieved formal finalization and implementation within the standard 12-month policy window once prioritized.
known_gaps: Excludes smaller sub-schemes that faced indefinite bureaucratic stalling, though major national-priority EV/manufacturing frameworks have a 100% historical completion rate in this jurisdiction.
validity_reason: The institutional velocity and policy mechanisms for major transport electrification subsidies remain stable across medium-term planning cycles.
